notes.frame: Phosphor's image (its centerlines cover all but 0.01 % of its ink at regular before the cut), with the bell-slash slash: the lower-left part runs into the slash, the upper-right part stops 32 units from it. The big mountain's right slope ran 7 to 13 units from the slash, almost parallel, so it would have merged into it: its left slope now runs on into the slash, which becomes the mountain's other side (as camera-slash does with its lens). The small mountain would have been cut down to a line parallel to the slash (a second slash), so it is left out; the sun stays.
notes.bold: The sun sits at (160, 96) with radius 16, where Phosphor's image-bold has it (it moves 4 up and right in bold).
